O navegador monta a árvore de acessibili: The browser builds the accessibility tree from the HTML: each control becomes a role (textbox, combobox, button) with a name. A ferramenta executa a ação no controle: The tool performs the action on the chosen control, using the reference from the tree (in agent-browser, for example, refs like @e2). Then it reads the tree again to see the result.
